ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows triangle ABC with A at the top, B and C on a horizontal base BC. Point D lies on side AB, point E lies on base BC, and point F lies on side AC. Segment DE is drawn parallel to AC, and segment EF is drawn parallel to AB, so ADEF forms a parallelogram with AD parallel EF and AF parallel DE. Reasoning: Since ADEF is a parallelogram, its perimeter is 2(AD + AF). Let BE and EC be the two parts of BC, so BE + EC = BC = 20. Because DE is parallel to AC, triangle BDE is similar to triangle BAC, so BD/AB = BE/BC. With AB = 28 and BC = 20, this gives BD/28 = BE/20. Because EF is parallel to AB, triangle EFC is similar to triangle CBA, so CF/AC = EC/BC. With AC = 28 and BC = 20, this gives CF/28 = EC/20. Adding the two equations gives BD/28 + CF/28 = (BE + EC)/20 = 20/20 = 1, so BD + CF = 28. Then AD + AF = (AB - BD) + (AC - CF) = 28 - BD + 28 - CF = 56 - (BD + CF) = 56 - 28 = 28. Therefore the perimeter of parallelogram ADEF is 2(28) = 56.

method.method_draft: Use similar triangles and the partition of the base. From the diagram/text, note that D lies on AB, E lies on BC, F lies on AC, with DE parallel AC and EF parallel AB, so ADEF is a parallelogram and its perimeter is 2(AD+AF). Let BE and EC be the two parts of BC. Because DE || AC, triangle BDE is similar to triangle BAC, giving BD/AB = BE/BC. Because EF || AB, triangle EFC is similar to triangle CBA, giving CF/AC = EC/BC. Since AB=AC=28 and BE+EC=BC=20, add the two relations to get BD/28 + CF/28 = (BE+EC)/20 = 1, so BD+CF=28. Then AD+AF=(AB-BD)+(AC-CF)=56-28=28, hence the parallelogram perimeter is 2(28)=56.

method.method_draft: Use an affine/vector parametrization of the two equal sides. Place A as the origin of the two side directions: write D=A+s(B-A) and F=A+t(C-A), where 0≤s,t≤1. Then AD=28s and AF=28t. Since ADEF is a parallelogram, the fourth vertex is E=D+F-A=A+s(B-A)+t(C-A). The condition that E lies on BC means E must be an affine combination of B and C with coefficients summing to 1; equivalently the coefficient of A in E is 1-s-t, so 1-s-t=0 and s+t=1. Therefore AD+AF=28s+28t=28, and the perimeter of parallelogram ADEF is 2(AD+AF)=56.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中三角形 ABC 的顶点 A 在上方，B、C 在底边两端；D 在边 AB 上，E 在边 BC 上，F 在边 AC 上。线段 DE 与 AC 平行，线段 EF 与 AB 平行，因此 A-D-E-F 构成一个平行四边形。

按指定的仿射/向量参数法求解。把 A 看作两条边方向的原点。设 D = A + s(B - A)，F = A + t(C - A)，其中 0 <= s,t <= 1。因为 AB = AC = 28，所以 AD = 28s，AF = 28t。

由于 ADEF 是平行四边形，第四个顶点 E = D + F - A = A + s(B - A) + t(C - A)。把它写成关于 A、B、C 的仿射组合：E = (1 - s - t)A + sB + tC。

又因为 E 在边 BC 上，所以 E 的仿射组合中 A 的系数必须为 0，即 1 - s - t = 0，因此 s + t = 1。

于是 AD + AF = 28s + 28t = 28(s + t) = 28。平行四边形 ADEF 的周长为 2(AD + AF) = 2 * 28 = 56。
